schema.X: Horizontal pixel coordinate in original video
schema.Y: Vertical pixel coordinate in original video
schema.Source: Coordinate-generation method; not a truth label

soccer.method: Actual sampled CNN detections from the separate local demo; existing pointAt() maps the measured sample trajectory onto each original video frame. Source explicitly distinguishes sample/interpolation/brief hold.

pingpong.method: measure_orange_ball.py processes each decoded frame with color and component-shape rules; missing estimates remain Visibility=0. No interpolation and no CNN in this coordinate generator.

note: The four rows in schema-example.csv are invented schema illustrations only; they are not positions for either sample video.

basketball.method: Actual MobileNetV1+SSD samples with CNN-seeded appearance measurements; pointAt maps adjacent valid samples onto original video frames. Missing samples break the path. Sources explicitly distinguish interpolation and measured points.

juggling.method: Actual MobileNetV1+SSD detections and CNN-seeded color measurements from 146 samples; pointAt maps valid neighboring measurements onto each original video frame, without crossing missing samples.
